parse.title: Shilo Village/Quick guide
parse.wikitext:
===Tomb of Bervirius===
{{Checklist|
*With your bronze wire and chisel, head south-west to [[Cairn Isle]], west of Shilo Village, near [[fairy ring]] {{Fairycode|CKR}}. Climb the rocks ({{SCP|Agility|15}}) and then cross the bridge. 
*Search the [[well stacked rocks]] on the northern side of the island, and then enter the crevice, requiring ({{SCP|Agility|32}}). '''If you can't get in the cave you didn't read the scrolls'''. 
*Head south and '''with at least 3 empty inventory spaces''' search the [[tomb dolmen (Tomb of Bervirius)|dolmen]]. If you had no space you'll have to return with [[charcoal]] and [[papyrus]] to get the notes. '''Do not drop the [[locating crystal]] or you will take 5-10 damage'''.
*Use a chisel on the [[sword pommel]].
*Use bronze wire on the bone beads.
*Teleport out or climb up the rockslide nearby to escape the cave (may take up to 10 damage if you fail).
}}
